title: Bristol Motor Speedway

services.name: Track Tours
services.desc: Come and tour the iconic half-mile at Bristol Motor Speedway! Tours will originate from the Speedway World Gift Store located on the first floor of the O. Bruton Smith Building located just off Hwy. 11E/ Volunteer Parkway. Each tour typically takes between 45-55 mins. This time may vary. Everyone going on tour will be required to sign a waiver. Tours WILL NOT be given during NASCAR events, one week before and the week after. Items purchased in store will receive 10% discount with purchase of tour on regular priced

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Bristol Motor Speedway and Dragway is a place where anything is possible! Where WOW moments and memories come to life. Host your next event or meeting at Bristol to take your guests to an experience that will have them saying thank you over and over again! The preeminent meeting space at Bristol Motor Speedway and Dragway. Countless variations of configurations. Host a meeting, a speech, a breakfast, lunch, dinner or dance party. All will work here. Complete with a full array of Audio/Visual tools, with climate control HVAC and a full catering kitchen. Also boasts a wonderful outside patio to enjoy the beautiful East Tennessee weather.
